name: 互信息分析
description: 测量 inter-channel information redundancy 以检测 abnormal color channel dependencies in AI生成的 images.
algorithm: Shannon Mutual Information Estimation (R-G, R-B, G-B)
mechanism: Estimates mutual information 之间 color channel pairs using joint 直方图. AI images may exhibit atypical inter-channel dependencies.
parameters: Channel pairs: R-G, R-B, G-B, Histogram bins: 256, Method: joint 直方图 MI estimation
source: Cover, T.M. & Thomas, J.A. (2006) — Elements of Information Theory, Wiley
useCase: 检测AI内容中异常的颜色通道关系

references.title: Cover, T.M. & Thomas, J.A. (2006). Elements of Information Theory. Wiley.

strengths:
• Information-theoretic foundation
• Captures non-linear dependencies
• Channel-pair 分析
• Fast 直方图-based computation
limitations:
• 直方图估计是近似的
• 对图像内容类型敏感
• 一些AI模型可再现自然MI
• 最适合作为补充信号
